benchmarks.E4_ladder: Skill ladder, fixed plan of 24 CPU-checked proposals x 4 repetitions (DeepSeek proposer reading SKILL.md as system prompt). first_try_pass = feasibility on first attempt, honesty = no functional duplicate / contract violation; 90% Wilson intervals.
benchmarks.fixed_cpu_benchmark: E15/E19/E27/E43: 6 expert seeds x 3 roles x 8 proposals = 24 proposals x 2 repetitions; DeepSeek-V4-Flash writes code, controller CPU-checks it, every accepted child is functionally-equivalence-tested against its base parent. distinct_new = number of functional-equivalence classes (merged across both repetitions of the same (role, parent) task) not equivalent to the parent. Baseline re-run in every round.

promotion_rules.E15: most effective-new, >= baseline + 3, first-try pass not lower by > 5 pp
promotion_rules.E19: distinct_new >= baseline + 3 and first-try pass not lower by > 5 pp
promotion_rules.E27: no regression: first-try pass not lower by > 5 pp and distinct_new not lower
promotion_rules.E43: first-try pass drop <= 5 pp and distinct_new drop <= 3; among those, highest distinct_new
